RateLimitWindowType.description: Counting algorithm for the minute, hour, and day limits of a rate limit.

oneOf.description: Each window starts at a fixed boundary (the top of the minute, hour, or day, UTC) and its count resets to zero when the next one starts. A burst at the end of one window and another at the start of the next can therefore admit up to twice the limit within one window's length.

A rolling window. Usage is recorded in sub-buckets aligned to a fixed step: 10 seconds for `rpm` and `tpm`, 5 minutes for `rph`, and 1 hour for `rpd` and `tpd`. A request is checked against the sum of the current sub-bucket and the preceding sub-buckets that cover one full window, so no window-length interval ever admits more than the limit. Usage leaves the count between one window and one window plus one step after it was recorded.

rph.description: Requests per 3,600-second window. There is no per-hour token limit field.

rps.description: Requests per 1-second window. There is no per-second token limit field.

window_type.description: How the minute, hour, and day limits count. `rps` and `concurrency` are unaffected.
